description.value: AHA Indian Food Paradise is a Surrey-based Indian restaurant that claims to be the first in the Lower Mainland to serve traditional Hyderabadi Dum Biryani, dosa, and all-day breakfast under one roof. The menu spans tandooris, chaats, parathas, and quality curries prepared with fresh ingredients and aromatic spices. Dine-in and takeout are both available, and the restaurant also offers catering services.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Surrey location of a two-location Indian restaurant chain (the other being in Aldergrove). The website lists the Surrey address as '202-13650 102Ave Surrey BC V3T 1N6', which conflicts with OSM's unit '102' and community 'North Vancouver' — both are flagged as concerns. Takeout is explicitly confirmed by the website ('Open Daily for Takeout & Delivery'; 'excellent takeaway service'); no evidence exists for bike parking, washrooms, or any cyclist-specific amenities.

OSM unit number is '102' but the website lists the Surrey location as unit '202' (202-13650 102 Ave Surrey BC V3T 1N6) — possible OSM data entry error.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed by an active website with ordering functionality and contact details. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a substantial Indian meal with takeout availability.
enrichment_extras.notes: This is one of two locations; the other is in Aldergrove (3087 271St, Aldergrove BC V4W 3H7, (604) 206-8484). The OSM record corresponds to the Surrey location based on the address match.
